flags: Coke-oven cache conflicts internally: introduction says 200 original ovens, history says 249 by 1899. Dropped current total of 200; retained supported 90 survivors. Ownership language is also inconsistent, so no present ownership asserted.
CDOT gives 205 miles, versus 203.3 mapped miles in material. Used CDOT. No designation date or National Forest designation found in cache; scenic and historic byway identity is supported.

Kebler moment is shorter because its cache is brief. Closure checked against saved CDOT evidence only, not live conditions. Middle Bridge cache has inconsistent reopening/painting chronology; no current bridge status asserted.

Other current claims are supported, including cottages, mansion, orchards and later oven habitation. Omitted cottages, mansion and habitation for focus. The Osgood toll-road plans are not identified as the origin of modern Highway 133.
